productArea.name: Notifications
productArea.scope: Configure notification providers, templates, required fields, defaults, monitor assignment, toast timing, and certificate or domain expiry thresholds, then create, edit, test, save, or delete notifications. Other monitor settings and external provider account setup are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Settings then Notifications, and add or edit a notification to select its provider and test or save it.
Use Setup Notification in a new monitor form, or follow Edit from an existing monitor to open the same dialog.
